steps.intro: Two songs to read from the staff, both with the right hand in the same five-finger position: thumb on middle {c}.
steps.auClair: “Au clair de la lune”, a French folk song. Learn it at your own pace.
steps.lightlyRow: “Lightly Row”, a German folk song. Watch out for the skips.
steps.inTime: Now play it in time with the metronome.
steps.twinkle: “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star”: at the start the hand reaches a little, finger 4 on {g} and 5 on {a}, then it settles back in place.
